decisions.decision: WORKER_REPLICA_COUNT env var for concurrency divisor (not RAILWAY_REPLICA_ID which is UUID)
decisions.rationale: RAILWAY_REPLICA_ID is a UUID string, cannot be used as integer divisor
No file overlap between concurrency scaling and shutdown/metrics work
Railway SIGKILL grace period is typically 30s, 25s leaves margin
